notes.title: Dystopia 1.5.4 hotfix
notes.content:
We're releasing a very small hotfix to Dystopia 1.5.4 today. Nothing critical, but we jumped the gun on releasing a feature a tad early.

With this update, Discord Rich Presence is fully supported, with all of its features fully utilized. Additionally, we explored small network console variable changes that should help for those that host servers. Happy graffing!

[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*]Added in a complete Discord Rich Presence
[list][*]Rich Presence will display the current map, round timer, and player class
[*]Players can invite each other by clicking + next to chat messages on Discord, or request to join within a user's profile[/list]
[*]Tweaked rate console variable to improve network responsiveness. If your server has made a change to this historically, it will not be overwritten by the new value
[*]Small versioning changes so that version properly reflects the client and server version. This will also prevent players from connecting to outdated servers.
[/list]

tags.feature: Added in a complete Discord Rich Presence
Rich Presence will display the current map, round timer, and player class
Players can invite each other by clicking + next to chat messages on Discord, or request to join within a user's profile

tags.balance_change: Tweaked rate console variable to improve network responsiveness.

tags.bug: Small versioning changes so that version properly reflects the client and server version. This will also prevent players from connecting to outdated servers.

notes.title: Dystopia 1.5.4 Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/708844/91f4c1ad96d79cbcb6187c01018481b85f2e091f.png[/img]
[h1]Dystopia 1.5.4[/h1]

Dystopia is a state of mind, and you just need to be in it.

[b]An awesome, persisting community[/b]
Since the 1.5.3 release more than two years ago, the fantastic community at large has been continuing to play Dystopia nightly. Whether through Steam groups or [url=https://discord.gg/punyhuman]our Discord Server[/url], people gather to play through a game that means so much to them, and to us. Thank you to those that still play and to the fantastic help we've received in testing this patch.

[b]Stats is back[/b]
We've worked tirelessly under the hood over the last few years to bring back the [url=https://dystopia-stats.com]Dystopia Stats website[/url]. It does not show anything at the moment, because as of this news post, we've rolled over the data. However, if you start playing in rounds, you'll be sure to see some fantastic data show up.

[b]The Wiki is coming[/b]
More on this later, but we're reviving the Dystopia Wiki, which took an extended hiatus.

We're excited to bring you these changes. Happy fragging.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]New animation and sound for Assault Rifle secondary fire
[*]Changed Tesla Rifle’s secondary max ammo usage to 25 instead of 20.
[*]Add predetermined spread for Shotgun to make it more consistent, doubled pellet count to 14 and halved damage to 4
[*]Minigun now applies slightly more knockback force on damaged players
[*]Assault Rifle primary spread maxes out at 20 bullets rather than 40
[*]Assault Rifle secondary fire’s pellets changed from 5 to 20, and damage-per-pellet from 15 to 6.
[*]Assault Rifle secondary fire now has a static spread pattern
[*]Grenade Launcher grenades will come out primed if the player is holding the right mouse click.
[*]Reduced Grenade Launcher grenade delay timer from 0.3 to 0.1
[*]Added basic Discord Rich Presence
[*]Added dys_draw_relative_nametag_color which makes names appear red or green based on enemy or ally, defaults off
[*]Set max FOV to 120
[*]Implemented MiniMP3 for mp3 audio playback.
[*]Undermine
[list][*]EU1 is a bit easier to navigate to the button[/list]
[*]Fortress 
[list][*]Added another turret to cover Corps Jack-In-Points
[*]Tall ICE in cyberspace 3rd objective can now be shot through[/list]
[*]Assemble
[list][*]Fixed upload bug on last objective[/list]
[*]Cybernetic
[list][*]Fixed hostage getting stuck in floor[/list]
[*]Coast
[list][*]Map is now fully textured with a few props
[*]Changed bomb defuse cracking time for 1st objective from 10 seconds to 20 seconds
[*]Made 1st objective node in cyberspace easier to access
[*]Removed 2nd objective lobby turret
[*]Added a jack-in-point to 2nd objective to bypass regular cyberspace
[*]Added some cyber floor in 3rd objective to allow changing orientation beyond gravity modifiers
[*]Changed small data chunk to be worth 15%, up from 10%
[*]Changed large data chunk to be worth 90%, up from 40%
[*]Removed middle cyberspace area in 3rd objective that controls the doors
[*]Meatspace is now open in 3rd objective by default allowing players to fight over the button more freely
[*]Weak virus changed to 40% from 20%, strong virus changed to 60% from 40%, and lethal virus changed to 100% from 60% (to one-shot the objective.)
[*]Removed awkward cube in cyberspace and relocated hatch and turret controls on 4th objective.
[*]Added a 15 second Meatspace crack that compromises the system 20% at a time
[*]Made hatch route in 4th objective stronger by removing a turret and adding a ladder
[*]Corps can no longer pick up the virus and delete it by taking it to their spawn.
[/list]
[*]Updated Russian translation (thanks Blueberry!)
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Make turrets lock onto and track players better, no more turret dancing
[*]Fix Grenade Launcher grenade bug causing the player to not detonate grenades on the ground as fast intended.
[*]Fix crash caused by the random music picker
[*]Stats page now opens the Steam overlay rather than a VGUI window and points to the right location
[*]Fix Tesla ball from going through dynamic objects
[/list]

notes.title: Dystopia 1.5.3 Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/708844/b5d1c11d860e4059dfe71df3a50a0aa41c1792bc.jpg[/img]
[h1]Dystopia 1.5.3[/h1]

Who would have thought that after 15 years Dystopia is receiving updates? 

[b]Our Discord and its wonderful community[/b]
1.5.2 released almost two years ago. Since then, we have continued development with the support of our fantastic community over [url=https://discord.gg/punyhuman]our Discord Server[/url]. We can’t believe the enormous amount of love and support we continue to receive from all of you.

[b]Moving our Bug Tracker[/b]
Today, Puny Human is releasing a big update to make Dystopia better than ever. In an effort to centralize bug reports, bug reports are moving to our internal [url=https://tracker.punyhuman.com]Bug Tracker[/url]. We appreciate the love, support, and bug reports and couldn’t continue developing without you! 

[b]Continuing Dystopia development[/b]
For the future, we hope to get the statistics system and Wiki running again, maintain servers, and hopefully release a Mac client. If you want to help with this, then head over to [url=https://punyhuman.com/crowdfund/dystopia]Dystopia’s crowdfunding page[/url], or maybe pick up a copy of [url=https://galaci.de/play-now]another one of our games[/url]? 

[url=https://punyhuman.com/crowdfund/dystopia][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/708844/61261918c5f695ad57cffe4a10aaa13d4f8c17ca.jpg[/img][/url]

We’ll be seeing you in cyberspace...

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated physics libraries to a newer version of Source Engine, fixing issues with props and player movement.
[*] Updated underlying networking to a newer version of Source Engine, for more responsiveness and reliability.
[*] Added experimental Vulkan API Support on Windows with -vulkan launch parameter.
[*] Made user interface default to gray for spectators or before choosing a team.
[*] Improved text and graphic scaling of the user interface on various resolutions.
[*] Increased maxplayers limit to 64.
[*] Increased the resolution and added an independent screen for the Rocket Launcher secondary weapon.
[*] Refactored voice-comm system to fix multiple issues.
[*] Spawn effect DSP now only occurs if you have the option selected in the Options menu.
[*] Forced DirectX9.5 (officially deprecating DirectX8.
[*] Removed XFire from various parts of the game.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed friendly grenades not showing unless the IFF Info implant was selected.
[*] Fixed giant blood sprites appearing when decapitating a player.
[*] Fixed view angles for spectators sometimes appearing wrong.
[*] Fixed not being able to import sprays.
[*] Fixed not being able to change class or weapons in grace periods
[*] Fixed music not playing on Linux.
[*] Fixed crash related to music playing on Windows when exiting the game.
[*] Fixed bugs regarding the implant/team selection box
[*] Fixed cortex bomb timer not counting down in meatspace if decking
[*] Fixed various bugs with the music manager.
[*] Fixed Achievement Announcement particles showing when the player is cloaked or with coldsuit enabled.
[*] Fixed a bug where you would add SCS in the grace period and you would not have 75 energy.
[*] Fixed bans sometimes not working for team-killers.
[*] Fixed intro videos not showing on Linux
[*] Fixed being able to spray paint Jack-in Points.
[*] Fixed Rocket Launcher firing the wrong missile model.
[*] Fixed spawn effect displaying improperly.
[*] Fixed being able to select a loadout if you attempted to join a full team.
[*] Fixed being able to see implants as a spectator, potentially leading to team imbalance.
[*] Fixed spawn sound effect lowering volume
[*] Fixed spawning via loadout change pointing you the wrong direction.
[*] Fixed ammo dispensers not showing up on minimap.
[*] Fixed away-from-keyboard kicking sometimes improperly occurring.
[*] Fixed Nade-fu achievement not unlocking.
[*] Fixed implant sounds getting stuck after death
[*] Fixed scoreboard size to be more evenly distributed for all resolutions.
[*] Fixed some particle effects rendering through walls
[*] Fixed objectives appearing twice on end-of-round scoreboard sometimes
[*] Fixed viewbob intense occurring when using Rocket Launcher secondary weapon. 
[*] Fixed clicking screens sometimes unintentionally making the player fire their weapon.
[*] Fixed hit beeps playing over the cyber screen mic.
[*] Fixed various clipping problems on dys_cybernetic. 
[*] Fixed being able to spam weapon change noise.
[*] Fixed round end screen hiding the chat window.
[*] Fixed chat window closing when a round is reset.
[*] Fixed localization files not being properly loaded.
[*] Fixed being able to issue voice commands and taunts while dead.
[*] Fixed Heavy not being able to taunt on killing a decker.
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: Dystopia Version 1.5.2 Released
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/708844/dcadfab65c2917de98668b4fec965d181e430b7b.png[/img]

[h1]Dystopia 1.5.2[/h1]
We've received a [url=https://www.patreon.com/punyhuman]few more Patreon contributions[/url], allowing us to continue work on Dystopia through the weekend this month. Thank you! 

On both our [url=https://github.com/punyhumangames/Dystopia/issues]Bug Tracker[/url], and the official [url=http://discord.gg/punyhuman]Discord Server[/url] everyone has been extremely helpful reporting bugs and joining us for play-test sessions. We appreciate it big time!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated UI to better match Dystopia aesthetic.
[*]Updated chat text to be somewhat larger.
[*]Fixed Cybernetic objective 3 spawn doors not opening for Punks.
[*]Fixed Vaccine objective 2 JIP door not opening for Punks.
[*]Attempt at fixing Fusion objective 1 spawn door for Punks.
[*]Added margin within death noticies / obituaries.
[*]Another attempt at fixing the tilted view (We think we got it this time people!)
[*]Fixed context-sensitive taunts ([i]I don't think so sistah![/i])
[*]Fixed global voicecomms not showing in chat.
[*]Fixed color of team chat and voicecomms.
[*]Fixed a number of client related crashes.
[*]Fixed round end panel buttons not changing color correctly.
[*]Fixed view jitter at round end.
[*]Fixed over-bloom for Windows clients.
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]We've started tracking them, [url=https://github.com/punyhumangames/Dystopia/issues]so check them out and find more to squash![/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Linux Client and 1.5 Update Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/708844/22131ccf8e549ec544525b568e365fcfb86bf45a.png[/img]


[b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/dystopia/announcements/detail/2738622771821837383]UPDATE: We've released version 1.5.1 with fixes and features![/url][/b]


[h1]Dystopia 1.5.0[/h1]
It’s been 3 years, 5 months and 22 days since a major update to Dystopia, and after some teasing (and subsequent delays,) we’re excited to bring you [b]Version 1.5.0[/b].

In addition to releasing our new games, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/225600/Blade_Symphony/]Blade Symphony[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/356790/Galacide/]Galacide[/url], 1.5.0 was delayed due to the challenges of upgrading the engine. Source SDK Base, a required dependency, would cause Dystopia to break any time it was updated, so we’ve removed that dependency.

Dystopia 1.5.0 is a new baseline. In the last 8 months, we’ve migrated our massive infrastructure, created a new build system distributed across numerous cloud machines, that compile on multiple platforms and architectures. This will allow us to release updates at a faster pace. 

To report bugs, please check out our [url=https://github.com/punyhumangames/Dystopia]Dystopia bug tracker on Github[/url], and join other players in the [url=http://discord.gg/punyhuman]official Puny Human Discord[/url]. The development of Dystopia 1.5 was paid for by [url=https://www.patreon.com/punyhuman]our lovely Patrons[/url]. Thank you to everyone!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Migrated Dystopia from Source SDK Base to HL2 version of Source Engine
[*]Added Linux Client
[*]Added anti-aliasing around all fonts in-game
[*]Changed chat text font from standard HL2 font to SpaceOne font
[*]Added Windowed (No Border) option
[*]Fixed shells the gun used (no longer uses CSS:S shells)
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Linux Dedicated Server binaries are not downloading using SteamCMD. (We're working with Valve on this. [url=http://www.dystopia-game.com/files/1.5-LinuxDS-bin-folder.zip]Get them here to host a server![/url] Put the bin dir in the same dir as core and dystopia)
[*]Source SDK Base still downloads. (We're working with Valve on this.)
[*]Splash movie and intro movie do not play.
[*]Third party maps are not included. (We plan on working with authors to migrate these to the new Dystopia workshop.)
[*]Players sometimes have their views tilted when they spawn.
[*]Voice comms aren't playing sounds.
[*]Jittering for high-ping players.
[/list]

notes.title: Dystopia beta branch update 1.4.03
notes.content:
Hey guys I just pushed some more beta changes live. Here's the changes:
[list][*] EMP and frag grenades now deploy 3x faster
[*] "+0.00" on energy bar only shows up when you're not full energy
[*] mediplant now heals self even if off (but not when emp'd)
[*] knockback from explosives increased by 50%
[*] maximum upwards velocity from damage tweaked: it used to be capped at 250, now it is uncapped, but any velocity over 250 is scaled down by 50%
[*] smartlocks tracer lock timeout after losing line-of-sight reduced from 5 seconds to 1 second
[*] smartlocks can now be reloaded to refill tracers even when out of reserve ammo
[*] wired reflexes now reduces machpistol spread by 50% (up from 20%). machpistol with WR now has a higher pitch firing sound to alert you of this change (will have a custom sound soon probably)
[*] GL nades are now more responsive when checking whether or not to explode while sitting on the ground (think time 200ms -> 100ms)
[*] machpistol can now be fired even while holding +attack2! and there was much rejoicing.
[/list]

notes.title: Dystopia 'beta' branch now available
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I just created a "beta" branch for Dystopia which is free for anyone to access to check out upcoming Dys content/changes.

Currently it just has new .dll's with some minor changes if anyone wants to test them (no linux server built yet).

Changes on the beta branch currently are:
[list][*] Players don't soft-collide while airborn
[*] Cortex no longer looks for breakables when deciding to explode
[*] Heavies can no longer horizontal legboost jump
[*] Shotgun damage per shell reverted to 1.3 values (7 pellets per shell, 8 damage per pellet)
[*] Minigun changes:[list]
    [*]Can now switch weapons even while spinning
    [*]Now fires 6 bullets that deal 5 damage each (previously was 3 bullets, 12 damage each)
    [*]Spread increased by 50%
    [*]Wind up time reduced from 1.0 to 0.75
    [*]Max speed while spinning reduced from 128 to 80 (this also affects ability to turn while hopping)
    [*]Rate of fire penalty for firing while in the air increased by 25%
[/list][/list]

To opt into the beta, [b]right cilck on Dystopia in your steam library and click on the "BETAS" tab, and then select "Beta" from the drop-down list.[/b] The game should then automatically download the necessary files to update to the beta branch. To return to default live build, select the "NONE" option from the drop down.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/G78yoC1.png[/img]

notes.title: New update - steam.inf resolved
notes.content:
Dystopia has been updated to version 5. This update should resolve problems where users received a "This Steam account does not own this game" or "No Steam logon" message when trying to connect to a Dystopia server. The steam.inf file that was included in the previous update has been removed, though players are still reported as playing "Source SDK Base" in Steam Friends. We are actively working on a solution to this outstanding issue.

The blank steam.inf file used by the hotfix is no longer required. If you followed the hotfix instructions, please remove this file to prevent any conflicts with future updates to Dystopia.

Server admins should verify that their servers have been updated to version 5.

notes.title: New update - steam.inf resolved
notes.content:
Dystopia has been updated to version 5. This update should resolve problems where users received a "This Steam account does not own this game" or "No Steam logon" message when trying to connect to a Dystopia server. The steam.inf file that was included in the previous update has been removed, though players are still reported as playing "Source SDK Base" in Steam Friends. We are actively working on a solution to this outstanding issue.

The blank steam.inf file used by the hotfix is no longer required. If you followed the hotfix instructions, please remove this file to prevent any conflicts with future updates to Dystopia.

Server admins should verify that their servers have been updated to version 5.
